name: Nespresso-Stats
description: Self-hosted dashboard for your Nespresso Vertuo capsule inventory: what you have, how many of each, brew history, coffee stats and optional auto-decrement when the machine brews a coffee. No login is built in - it is made for a trusted home network. Expose it to the internet only behind an authenticating reverse proxy.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Holds the SQLite database (nespresso.db). Delete it to re-seed the starter capsule catalogue.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the Nespresso Stats web dashboard.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the app runs as. Default 99 = nobody.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the app runs as. Default 100 = users.

variables.name: VISION_BASE_URL
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for photo identify. 127.0.0.1 is the container itself, so point this at your Ollama host, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1.

variables.name: VISION_MODEL
variables.description: Vision model name. Leave empty to turn vision off and identify capsules by colour alone.

variables.name: VISION_API_KEY
variables.description: API key for the vision endpoint. Ignored by a local Ollama; set your Ollama Cloud key when using https://ollama.com/v1.
